lead: Cut by entity, never by line number, and check the count afterwards.
body: A range that starts one line late leaves a `#[test]` attached to the previous item — which is a silent lost test, not an error, unless the function happens to take arguments. `grep -c '#\[test\]'` before and after, and the test count in `verify.py`'s output, are the two checks that catch it.
